mapper.insert: insert into measuring_station ( code, name, water_name, river_name, monitor_code, address_code, establish_date, longitude, latitude, note, create_time, update_time, point ) values ( #{code}, #{name}, #{waterName}, #{riverName}, #{monitorCode}, #{addressCode}, #{establishDate}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{note}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, st_pointfromtext(#{geom}) )
